families.label: Sky aspect fallback
families.selection: Use aspect behavior as the base. Add a specific aspect-pair row only when that exact pair exists; otherwise keep the copy aspect-level and concrete.

families.label: Transit to natal fallback
families.selection: Use planet-to-planet and modifier rows first. Only add house language when the receiving chart has reliable birth time.

families.label: Ingress fallback
families.selection: Compose planet-in-sign lived behavior with the ingress row; avoid keyword lists.

families.label: Retrograde phase fallback
families.selection: Use the phase row for timing behavior and the planet row for the reviewed function.

families.label: Retrograde per-planet fallback
families.selection: Use Marie's per-planet retrograde flavor for the reviewed planet function.

families.label: Eclipse fallback
families.selection: Use the matching exported eclipse fallback row as reference-lane seed vocabulary when the sign/type is known. Authored fallback-hook/sky.eclipse.* rows remain DRAFT until editorial approval.

families.label: Multi-retrograde fallback
families.selection: Retrieve one ms/retrograde row for each currently retrograde planet and synthesize the shared pacing without doom language.

families.label: Synastry short fallback
families.selection: Start with contact behavior, then context stakes and helps. Add house overlay only when the receiving chart has reliable birth time.

families.label: Planet lived-behavior vocab
families.selection: Use planet function/productive/excess with the sign lived-behavior row as generation context only.

referenceLanePolicy: Reference-lane vocabulary is generation context only. Reader-facing fetches must require serving lane, published/reviewed status, and empty review blockers.
